subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Malala Speaks After Being Shot
description: A short lesson to help you apply Malala Speaks After Being Shot.

hook.text: The Taliban shot Malala Yousafzai in the head for advocating girls' education. She survived and spoke louder.

buildup.text: After recovery, she could have stayed silent and safe. Instead, she addressed the United Nations at age 16.

discovery.text: Her speech went viral. She became the youngest Nobel Prize laureate. The bullet weaponized her voice.

twist.text: The Taliban's choice to silence her created the opposite effect. Their attack gave her a global amplifier.

climax.text: Malala shows that choosing to persist after a setback can be more powerful than the original action.

punchline.text: They shot to silence her. She became the loudest voice on Earth.

quiz.question: How did the Taliban's attack on Malala backfire?
options: It gave her global attention and amplified the cause they tried to silence
